subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Pranav, Shagun and Munshi took a bus to the same ________.
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(3) i.e. **'Destination'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **destination** means the place where somebody/something is going.**(गंतव्य)**
 
• **Example:-** After stopping for lunch, we continued on toward our destination. 

Therefore,the correct answer is option no. **(3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options are-**
 
• **Slot- **To put something into a particular space that is designed for it.**(खांचा)**
 
 
• The time **slot** remained the same for one week.
 
 
 
• **End- **The place or time where something stops or last part of something.**(अंत)**
 
 
• The report is due at the **end** of the month.
 
 
 
• **Target-** A result that you try to achieve.**(लक्ष्य)**
 
 
• The missiles missed their target.
